description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity for a libwebsockets test service. It manages connection lifecycle, UI interactions, and communication with an Android service called LwsService, enabling WebSocket client functionality within an Android app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages WebSocket client connections through a background service, handles UI updates, and implements output handling interface.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, binds UI elements, and establishes service connection.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Preserves thread running state across configuration changes.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Binds the activity to the LwsService for communication.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Unbinds from service and pauses the thread if running when the activity stops.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops the service if the activity is finishing.

methods.name: handleOutputMessage
methods.description: Handles messages received from the LwsService to update UI and internal state accordingly.

methods.name: connectErrorListener
methods.description: Displays an error dialog and stops the connection thread if a connection error occurs.

methods.name: clickStart
methods.description: Handles start/stop button click to initiate or stop WebSocket connection.
